profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I joined the U.S. Army with the intent to improve myself and make the world a better place. During my time in, I learned soft skills such as resilience, leadership, and dedication that helps me excel in the modern workplace. From there, I've built a career with my current employer, where I've been given the opportunity to connect with fascinating and successful individuals and to learn new skills relating to data analysis in GIS.

I broadened my horizons by studying computer science and aviation at Kent State University to be able to transition into a role with greater responsibility and impact.

Now, I am a motivated, self-starting veteran with experience in modern web technologies. I fill a role that engages in projects making a positive impact on the world alongside an energetic and talented team. I continue to prove my ability to contribute effectively in a dynamic environment and I always strive to expand my depth of knowledge through mentorship from experienced professionals and completing challenging projects.

projects.title: My Earth Web Application
projects.description:
- Users can share notes and see them pinned to a 3D globe rendered with three.js in their browser.
- Uses Tensorflow to run a machine learning model that detects toxic language in user-submitted content.
- CI/CD pipeline implemented with Docker and Github Actions and Container Registry.
- Uses PostgreSQL with the PostGIS extension to efficiently store and retrieve geospatial data.

projects.title: Personal Timekeeping Web Application
projects.description:
- Allows a single user to track their time spent at work.
- Implemented with Nuxt, Vue.js, TailwindCSS, and SQLite.
- Uses websockets, service workers, and other advanced web browser APIs to enable unique features.
- Second version of a previously desktop-based WPF application written in C#.
